description: UCI row 63 (age 25, MEDIUM vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 4, horizon 6yr) — government bond: all hard rules pass (score 100) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Rasa Vaitkienė is 25 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 30,700 euros (around 2,558 euros per month). They hold 2,600 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 18,400 euros with a 6-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is moderate-to-conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 4 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 18,400 euros invested. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a German federal government bond (Bund) with a ten-year maturity, denominated in euros and listed on regulated exchanges. It carries a AAA sovereign credit rating and pays a fixed coupon semi-annually. The instrument is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a) and requires basic financial knowledge to understand. The recommended minimum holding period is three years.
